pages.text: New config screen. Open it with the Config button in the mod list or with the command /farview config.$(br2)New client settings: far blast effects, far missiles and far missile smoke can each be turned off. Changes apply at once, without a restart.

NTM missiles are now visible from far away, in flight, beyond the render distance.$(br2)The exhaust flame and smoke behind a missile is also drawn at a long distance. With distance it is thinner and larger.$(br2)Missiles are hidden by Distant Horizons hills, like the mushroom cloud.

The default and maximum of farTrackingRange are now 4096 blocks (it was 1024). An older config file may still contain 1024.$(br2)This range is not fully tested, especially on dedicated servers. If you have problems such as lag, lower the value and report the problem with your latest.log.
Distant Horizons support.$(br2)Far hills drawn by Distant Horizons now hide the mushroom cloud. Only the part behind a hill is hidden, also while you move around.
Vanilla Fade Mode in Distant Horizons still has to be set to None.$(br2)A chat hint is shown after joining a world while it is on.

Shader packs do not work correctly with Distant Horizons. Using Distant Horizons without a shader pack (vanilla rendering) is recommended.$(br2)With a shader pack the cloud is only hidden when a hill covers all of it.
